description: Read the user's food diary across a date range, with per-day calorie/macro totals. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.
name: get_range
